title: Internal edge gateway terraform module: NLB->ALB traffic shaping and TLS termination
creator: Asha Patel
description:
Goal:
Create a reusable Terraform module that provisions an internal edge gateway inside customer VPCs for Redwood Private deployments. The module should support an upstream NLB for preserving source IPs and optional TLS passthrough, and an ALB for HTTP(S) routing, TLS termination and advanced routing/traffic shaping. It must include robust health check configuration, connection draining, and upgrade-friendly knobs (canary/blue-green).

Why: 
Customers deploying Redwood Private require a predictable internal ingress pattern that supports mixed workloads (ECS/EKS/VMs), consistent healthchecks for rolling upgrades, and secure TLS termination options that meet enterprise compliance. Historically we've had multiple ad-hoc scripts per customer; this module will standardize and reduce ops burden.

Non-goals:
- Public internet-facing listeners (this is internal VPC-only).
- Replacing customer-managed service meshes. Module should be compatible with mesh backends.

Acceptance criteria:
- Terraform module variables documented and cover vpc_id, private_subnets, nlb_enabled, alb_enabled, listener_ports, certificate_arn (optional), health_check_path, target_type (ip|instance), enable_proxy_protocol, connection_draining_timeout, enable_blue_green, canary_percentage, tags.
- Creates NLB+ALB topology when both enabled, with correct target groups for ALB and pass-through/forwarding for NLB where applicable.
- Supports TLS termination on ALB using ACM certs or user-provided ARN and enforces TLS 1.2+.
- Health checks configurable per target group: HTTP(S) path, interval, timeout, healthy/unhealthy thresholds and support for TCP gRPC probe variants.
- Connection draining (deregistration delay) configurable and defaulted to 300s for graceful AI model inferences.
- Outputs include listener ARNs, target group ARNs, security group IDs, and dashboard link template for Console.
- Module runs in CI (terraform validate/plan) and has unit examples in examples/ with EKS and ECS service examples.

Constraints / Notes:
- Preserve client IP for audit logs. When TLS is terminated at ALB we will inject X-Forwarded-For; when TLS passthrough is used with NLB must enable proxy protocol v2 and document application changes.
- For customers with strict key management, ACM PCA or customer-provided certs must be supported; IAM policy must be scoped to the certificate ARN.
- Cross-zone load balancing enabled by default.

Implementation risks:
- Wide variety of customer subnets/VPC setups; test matrix must include single AZ and multi-AZ VPCs.
- TLS termination decisions affect auditing and SLOs (latency added when decrypting on ALB).

Deliverables:
- Terraform module under infra/modules/internal-edge-gateway (public repo PR).
- Example stacks for EKS and ECS in examples/ .
- Confluence design doc capturing decision log and upgrade strategy.
- CI job to run terraform fmt/validate/plan in PRs.
acceptance_criteria: module variables and docs for vpc_id, private_subnets, nlb_enabled, alb_enabled, listener_ports, certificate_arn, health_check_path, target_type, enable_proxy_protocol, connection_draining_timeout, enable_blue_green, canary_percentage, tags
NLB+ALB topology created correctly when enabled together
TLS termination on ALB with ACM or provided certs and TLS 1.2+ enforcement
configurable health checks including HTTP/TCP/gRPC options
CI validation and examples for EKS/ECS
comments: 2025-02-11 - Asha Patel: Initial ticket created after spike. Spike notes attached in Confluence (link in attachments). Prototyped a module that creates ALB when alb_enabled=true and NLB when nlb_enabled=true. Still need to wire listener forwarding and health checks correctly.

2025-02-13 - Diego Ramirez: Reviewed prototype. Notes: (1) Ensure proxy protocol v2 toggle for NLB listeners (some EKS services depend on source IP). (2) Use target_type=ip default for EKS Fargate compatibility. (3) Add IAM policy example for reading ACM cert ARNs from customer accounts.

2025-02-15 - Priya Singh (Security): Security review checklist requested. Need to add TLS policies enforcing TLS 1.2 and above, ALB access logging to S3, KMS key usage documented, and note that customer-provided certs require RBAC for secrets managers. Marking security_review_required=true.

2025-02-17 - Diego Ramirez: Implemented health check knobs (http path, interval, timeout, thresholds) and added gRPC health probe option in module. Pushed branch infra/modules/internal-edge-gateway and opened PR: github.com/redwood/infra/pull/982 (link in attachments).

2025-02-19 - QA (Jordan Lowe): Integration tests ran against a 3-AZ VPC with EKS example. Observed flapping for one target group when using short deregistration delay (30s). Recommendation: default 300s and make configurable. Created follow-up task to add canary rollout example using target group weight shifting.
